scope: One fixed offline postprocessor on frozen C0 first groups; 26 development tasks, DS and three GPT banks; no training or calls
signal: Retained reasoning last flat index-bearing JSON, same frozen regex extractor as source audit. Both extracted and archived indices must be strict integer 0/1, excluding bool. Direction mismatch alone flags; confidence mismatch alone never flags. This is an apparent consistency signal, never adjudicated truth; intermediate reasoning JSON can create false flags.
audit_schema_disclosure: Audit lacks reasoning_last_json_index in every row. Recover via source_file/source_row prediction.reasoning; verify source hashes against frozen source audit and candidate path suffix order against frozen feedback order, plus presence/index/confidence and old mixed mismatch fields. Never inspect raw scores/correctness before seal.
text_rule: Only original C0 ties: if any accepted queried flagged edge touches a finalist, compute finalist penalty flagged wins minus flagged losses over accepted queried edges; retain minimizers within original first group. Otherwise retain entire C0 group.
control: 32 deterministic shuffles per episode of flag positions across accepted queried edges, preserving number of flags. Same finalist minimization rule, no flags means no trigger. Seed SHA256(experiment:bank:job:replicate). Control reported as replicate mean, plus replicate distribution.
selection_seal: Write all C0/text/sham selected sets and extracted flag metadata, hash seal, verify C0 against frozen reference and feedback source order/gate, before labels are opened.
metrics: Within episode uniform tie expected normalized regret and best-hit; average episodes within task, then tasks equally. GPT pooled averages banks within task then tasks. Paired task-cluster bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 812808, percentile 95% CI. Leave-one-task-out sign stability.
diagnostic: Unique accepted strict pairs with explicit reasoning index: archive winner accuracy grouped by direction match/mismatch, bank, task and confidence bands [0.7,0.8),[0.8,0.9),[0.9,1]. Raw conditioning only; no causal interpretation.
gate: DS C0-minus-text regret gain >=0.01; GPT pooled gain >0; text beats mean sham in both; 95% paired bootstrap lower bounds >0 for text-v-C0 and text-v-sham, and all leave-one-task-out gains >0, in both DS and GPT pooled. Otherwise close this exact text signal; no followup experiments.
